title: Valuation Memorandum: Part-Year Surrender Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
This memorandum states how the part-year surrender interest on an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract is computed.

## Formal statement

1. **Period.** The part-year surrender interest runs from the date of the contract's most recent interest credit through the date the signed surrender request was received, counted in actual calendar days.
2. **Rate.** It is credited at the guaranteed rate of the current guarantee period.
3. **Amount.** It is the contract value times the daily equivalent of that annual effective rate for those days: the contract value times one plus the rate raised to the power of the days over 365, less one, rounded to the cent. The rounding is made once, at the end.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Source in the records |
|---|---|
| Contract value | The current contract value on the contract record |
| Most recent interest credit | The date of the latest interest credit entry in the contract's activity history |
| Receipt of the signed surrender request | The received date of the contract's signed full surrender request |
| Rate | The guaranteed rate shown on the contract record for the current guarantee period |
| Days | The number of calendar days from the most recent interest credit date to the receipt date (from 10 March to 11 March is 1 day) |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Contract value $100000.00; guaranteed rate 5.30%; most recent interest credit 10 March; signed full surrender request received 25 April.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Days from 10 March to 25 April | 46 |
| One plus the rate, raised to the power of 46 over 365 | 1.0065297 (to seven places) |
| Less one, times $100000.00 | $652.9688... |
| Rounded to the cent | $652.97 |

Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities credit this amount to the contract value as the interest closing the contract for the surrender.
